title: Superhuman Remote Worker Helm values
description: Phase 1 structural validation: types and enums for high-signal fields. Intentionally permissive (additionalProperties allowed) so forward-compatible keys and existing values overlays are not rejected. Cross-field semantics (internal/external requirements, license acceptance, nats mutual-exclusion, neo4j enterprise license) stay in template `required`/`fail` guards.

username.description: Initial bundled SRW realm administrator; empty preserves the existing identity, or defaults to test on a fresh install.

rawPathVerified.description: Deprecated (2026-07-14), no effect: raw-path fidelity is an optional property of the operator's edge, not a launch gate. See knowledge-base/knowledge/issues/canvas_hosted_edge_use_cloudflare_tunnel.md.

install.description: Removed compatibility tombstone. CloudNativePG must be installed as a separate infrastructure release; true is rejected to prevent unsafe operator deletion during upgrade.

tuning.description: Memory GUCs derived from each database's own resources.limits.memory. 0 disables that GUC and falls back to the operand default.

sharedBuffersPercent.description: shared_buffers as a percent of limits.memory.

effectiveCacheSizePercent.description: effective_cache_size as a percent of limits.memory. A planner hint; allocates nothing.

enabled.description: null = auto: run the bundled object store unless s3.endpoint is set. true/false are explicit and always win.

ephemeralStorageClass.description: Storage class for per-workspace PVCs (jobs and sessions). Required when resourceQuota.enabled, which is keyed on it.

pvcEnabled.description: PVC-back workspace pods for BOTH jobs and sessions; sessions additionally get a second claim for their agent pod. Default false = emptyDir.

reclaimOnIdle.description: Drop a session's workspace PVC on idle-suspend once its S3 snapshot verifies restorable, instead of retaining it. Default false = retain-on-idle (today's behavior).
